title.zh: 国际能源署技术合作计划

aliases: 国际能源署技术合作计划

summary.zh: 通过跨国专家组开展能源技术研发与示范，将政府、研究机构和产业需求连接到共同任务。
summary.en: International expert groups connect governments, research organisations and industry through energy RD&D tasks.

actors.zh: 国际能源署合作框架；各技术合作计划的政府、产业及研究参与方。
actors.en: IEA cooperation framework and the government, industry and research participants of individual programmes.

mechanism.zh: 围绕共同技术问题组织任务，参与方共享专业知识与研究工作；具体任务和资源承诺由各计划安排。
mechanism.en: Participants organise tasks around shared technical problems; individual programmes arrange work and resource commitments.

observed.zh: 框架成立于1975年；官网按技术领域提供在运行的合作计划目录，供研究机构与产业方识别合作入口。
observed.en: Established in 1975, the framework provides a directory of ongoing programmes by technology area for research and industrial participants.

constraints.zh: 共同目标有助于合作持续，但各方投入、数据权限和成果使用仍需在任务层面明确。
constraints.en: Shared goals support cooperation, but task-level agreements still need to define contributions, data access and use of results.

transfer.zh: 后发国家可从有本地应用场景的任务切入，以试验数据和专业人才交换知识，而非复制全部研发体系。
transfer.en: Latecomer countries can enter tasks relevant to local applications, contributing test data and expertise rather than duplicating entire R&D systems.

title.zh: 德国弗劳恩霍夫应用研究与国际合作
title.en: Fraunhofer applied research and international cooperation

summary.zh: 以企业委托研发、长期合作和创新集群衔接科学研究与工业应用，并通过国际合作连接外部能力。
summary.en: Contract research, strategic partnerships and innovation clusters connect applied science with industrial use and international capabilities.

actors.zh: 弗劳恩霍夫研究机构、企业、大学及国际合作伙伴。
actors.en: Fraunhofer institutes, companies, universities and international partners.

mechanism.zh: 企业技术需求进入合同研发；长期合作支持连续研发，集群与衍生企业拓展成果转化路径。
mechanism.en: Industrial problems enter contract research; long-term partnerships, clusters and spin-offs provide routes to translation.

observed.zh: 官方合作指南提供合同研发、长期战略伙伴、创新集群和衍生企业四类转化渠道；国际布局结合伙伴与市场分析。
observed.en: Official guidance identifies contract R&D, strategic partnerships, clusters and spin-offs; international engagement includes partner and market assessment.

constraints.zh: 模式依赖稳定的应用研究能力与企业付费需求；研究机构数量并不能替代技术吸收能力。
constraints.en: The model needs sustained applied-research capabilities and firms able to commission research; institute counts cannot substitute for absorptive capacity.

transfer.zh: 先建立面向产业共性难题的研究单元与清晰合同，再开展跨境合作；经费结构需适应当地企业能力。
transfer.en: Build specialised units and clear contracts around industrial problems first; adapt funding arrangements to local firms before scaling international cooperation.

title.zh: 麻省理工能源计划产业会员合作

summary.zh: 产业会员将现实能源问题与MIT研究团队连接，通过研究支持和行业交流对接科研议题。
summary.en: Industry membership connects real-world energy problems with MIT research teams through research support and exchange.

actors.zh: MIT Energy Initiative、不同规模企业以及公共部门会员。
actors.en: MIT Energy Initiative, companies of different sizes and public-sector members.

mechanism.zh: 会员提供产业问题与研究机会，研究团队开展相关研究；分层参与方式拓展合作入口。
mechanism.en: Members bring industrial problems and research opportunities; tiered participation provides different entry routes.

observed.zh: 会员制度面向不同规模的企业及公共部门，提供研究交流、合作机会和跨学科能源研究的参与渠道。
observed.en: Membership offers research exchange, collaboration opportunities and interdisciplinary energy engagement to firms of different sizes and public-sector organisations.

constraints.zh: 大企业与中小企业的研究预算和议题影响力可能不同，应单独安排可负担的参与方式。
constraints.en: Large and smaller firms differ in research budgets and agenda-setting capacity; affordable participation routes matter.

transfer.zh: 高校平台可将产业问题清单、跨学科研发和可分层参与的合作制度结合，避免只依赖单一资助方。
transfer.en: University platforms can combine industrial problem lists, interdisciplinary research and tiered engagement to avoid dependence on one sponsor.

title.zh: 欧盟清洁氢能伙伴关系

summary.zh: 公共部门、产业与研究界联合支持氢能研发和示范，将制氢、储运与终端应用纳入协同布局。
summary.en: Public authorities, industry and researchers jointly support hydrogen research and demonstration across production, storage, distribution and use.

actors.zh: 欧盟委员会、Hydrogen Europe与Hydrogen Europe Research。
actors.en: European Commission, Hydrogen Europe and Hydrogen Europe Research.

mechanism.zh: 以公私伙伴关系组织研发项目，并通过氢谷将不同环节与区域需求衔接。
mechanism.en: A public–private partnership organises projects, while hydrogen valleys connect value-chain activities with regional needs.

observed.zh: 公私伙伴关系将欧盟委员会、产业组织与研究组织纳入共同架构；氢谷项目将生产、储运和终端使用在区域层面连接。
observed.en: The partnership joins the Commission, industry and research organisations; hydrogen valleys connect production, storage, distribution and use at regional level.

constraints.zh: 氢谷适配取决于电力成本、稳定用氢需求、基础设施与许可条件，不能仅靠设备投资形成生态。
constraints.en: Valley suitability depends on electricity costs, sustained hydrogen demand, infrastructure and permits, not equipment investment alone.

transfer.zh: 以明确终端需求组织产业伙伴，将共同研发、示范设施与基础设施责任同步安排。
transfer.en: Organise partners around concrete demand, aligning joint research and demonstration facilities with infrastructure responsibilities.

title.zh: Eurostars中小企业跨境联合研发

summary.zh: 由创新型中小企业牵头国际研发联合体，以市场导向项目连接不同国家的企业和科研团队。
summary.en: Innovative SMEs lead international consortia linking companies and researchers through market-oriented R&D.

actors.zh: Eureka网络、欧盟及参与国资助机构；瑞士由Innosuisse提供项目支持。
actors.en: Eureka, the EU and participating funding agencies, including Innosuisse in Switzerland.

mechanism.zh: 共同项目与国际评审对接国家资助体系；资格、可资助费用和支持强度受参与方所在地规则约束。
mechanism.en: Joint projects connect international assessment with national funding; eligibility and support remain subject to domestic rules.

observed.zh: 公开资格指南要求创新型中小企业牵头并组成独立实体联合体；瑞士官方页面说明其如何对接国际项目与本国支持。
observed.en: Public eligibility guidance requires an innovative SME lead and independent consortium entities; Swiss guidance explains the international-to-national funding interface.

constraints.zh: 协调难点在于多国资助节奏、联合体责任和成果分配，而非单纯增加合作伙伴数量。
constraints.en: Coordination centres on funding schedules, consortium responsibilities and allocation of results, not partner counts.

transfer.zh: 区域间复制时，应先协调国家资助接口、项目退出与知识产权约定，再开放企业联合申报。
transfer.en: For regional replication, align funding interfaces, exit procedures and IP agreements before opening joint applications.

title.zh: 新加坡先进再制造与技术中心
title.en: Singapore Advanced Remanufacturing and Technology Centre

summary.zh: 通过公私合作和会员联合体，将应用研究转向产业制造、再制造和能源装备解决方案。
summary.en: A public–private membership consortium connects applied research with manufacturing, remanufacturing and energy-equipment solutions.

actors.zh: A*STAR、南洋理工大学，以及跨国企业、中小企业和初创企业会员。
actors.en: A*STAR, Nanyang Technological University and multinational, SME and start-up members.

mechanism.zh: 研究能力与产业会员需求在同一平台对接，合作覆盖能源等行业，促进技术试验与工业应用。
mechanism.en: Research capabilities meet member demand on a shared platform spanning energy and other industries.

observed.zh: 能源与航空、快消品、陆路交通、生物医药制造一起被列为五个产业支柱，联合体吸纳跨国企业、中小企业和初创企业。
observed.en: Energy is one of five pillars alongside aerospace, FMCG, land transport and biomedical manufacturing; membership includes multinationals, SMEs and start-ups.

constraints.zh: 转化能力依赖本地工程人才、试验设施和企业共同定义问题的能力。
constraints.en: Translation depends on local engineering skills, test facilities and the ability to jointly define industrial problems.

transfer.zh: 可围绕区域主导产业建设共享应用研究中心，使中小企业接入跨国企业的研发和供应链需求。
transfer.en: Build shared applied-research centres around regional industries, connecting smaller firms with multinational R&D and supply-chain needs.

title.zh: 巴西EMBRAPII产业研发与国际合作
title.en: Brazil EMBRAPII industrial R&D and international cooperation

summary.zh: 经认证的研究单元与企业共同定义研发项目，并以公共支持分担前竞争阶段的研发成本。
summary.en: Accredited research units and firms define R&D projects, with public support sharing pre-competitive development costs.

actors.zh: EMBRAPII、巴西研究与技术机构、企业及国际合作资助伙伴。
actors.en: EMBRAPII, Brazilian research and technology institutions, companies and international funding partners.

mechanism.zh: 企业直接与研究单元协商技术和商业范围；国际项目由各国伙伴分别向本国支持机构申报。
mechanism.en: Firms negotiate technical and commercial scope with research units; international partners apply through their respective national agencies.

observed.zh: 国际合作流程要求巴西企业与国外伙伴分别在本国申报，企业可直接与研究单元协商技术与商业范围。
observed.en: International procedures require Brazilian and foreign partners to apply domestically; firms negotiate technical and commercial scope with research units.

constraints.zh: 研究单元能力与企业需求是否匹配，以及两国资助条件是否同步，是跨境项目的重要约束。
constraints.en: The fit between research capabilities and firm demand, alongside coordination of national funding conditions, constrains cross-border projects.

transfer.zh: 后发国家可认证已有研究机构，而非先新建大量机构，以产业合同和绩效要求组织国际研发接口。
transfer.en: Latecomer countries can accredit existing institutions and organise international R&D around industrial contracts and capability requirements.

title.zh: 摩洛哥Green Innoboost绿色创新支持
title.en: Morocco Green Innoboost green innovation support

summary.zh: 将创新资金、创业支持与绿色能源试验设施结合，帮助技术团队连接科研平台和商业伙伴。
summary.en: Innovation finance, venture support and green-energy test facilities connect technology teams with research platforms and commercial partners.

actors.zh: IRESEN、创新团队、大学、企业及潜在投资者。
actors.en: IRESEN, innovators, universities, companies and prospective investors.

mechanism.zh: 提供Green Energy Park等设施入口，同时支持采购服务、技术试验与投资者联系。
mechanism.en: Access to facilities such as Green Energy Park is combined with services procurement, testing and investor connections.

observed.zh: 国际能源署记录资金、设施和投资者对接支持，并指出IRESEN支持科特迪瓦太阳能研究平台，以测试热带条件下的技术。
observed.en: IEA documents finance, facilities and investor connections, and records IRESEN support for a solar research platform in Côte d'Ivoire to test tropical conditions.

constraints.zh: 设施可用性必须与工程辅导和本地市场需求结合；试验条件不同会影响技术适配。
constraints.en: Facility access must be combined with engineering support and local demand; environmental differences affect suitability.

transfer.zh: 将公共试验平台与创业服务打包，跨区域推广时先验证当地气候、维护能力和付费需求。
transfer.en: Bundle public testing with venture services, and validate climate, maintenance capabilities and customer demand before regional transfer.

title.zh: ITER国际聚变研发与实物贡献机制
title.en: ITER international fusion research and in-kind contributions

summary.zh: 成员共同建设大型聚变科研装置，通过实物贡献、共享实验结果和知识产权安排组织跨国研发。
summary.en: Members jointly develop a fusion research facility through in-kind contributions and arrangements for shared results and intellectual property.

actors.zh: 中国、欧盟、印度、日本、韩国、俄罗斯、美国；装置位于法国。
actors.en: China, EU, India, Japan, Korea, Russia and the US; the facility is located in France.

mechanism.zh: 成员分担建设等成本，国内机构对接设备供给，国际协议界定组织治理及成果共享。
mechanism.en: Members share costs and supply equipment through domestic agencies; international agreements define governance and sharing of results.

observed.zh: 成员共同承担建设、运行和退役成本，并共享实验结果与项目产生的知识产权；装置用于验证聚变的科学和技术可行性。
observed.en: Members share construction, operation and decommissioning costs, experimental results and generated IP; the facility tests scientific and technological feasibility of fusion.

constraints.zh: 大型设施合作要求长期资金承诺、接口标准与可执行的治理安排，不能等同于一般企业研发联盟。
constraints.en: Large-facility cooperation requires long-term financing, interface standards and implementable governance, unlike a routine business R&D alliance.

transfer.zh: 对高投入共性技术，可学习共享设施与贡献责任设计；应限定任务边界并明确成果使用和退出条件。
transfer.en: For capital-intensive technologies, shared facilities and contribution responsibilities are transferable, provided task boundaries and result-use conditions are explicit.

title.zh: WIPO GREEN绿色技术供需对接

sector.zh: 绿色技术与知识产权交易

aliases: 世界知识产权组织绿色

summary.zh: 通过技术与需求数据库连接绿色技术供给者和寻求解决方案的机构，提供许可、合作和合资线索。
summary.en: A technology-and-needs database connects green-technology suppliers and seekers, providing leads for licensing, collaboration and joint ventures.

actors.zh: 世界知识产权组织、技术持有者、企业、机构和非政府组织。
actors.en: WIPO, technology holders, companies, institutions and NGOs.

mechanism.zh: 供给方发布技术，需求方描述应用问题，平台开展自动匹配并连接技术与潜在使用者。
mechanism.en: Suppliers list technologies and seekers state application needs; automated matching connects potential counterparts.

observed.zh: 公开数据库覆盖从原型到可销售产品，允许发布出售、许可、合作和合资信息，并支持技术与需求的自动匹配。
observed.en: The public database covers prototypes through marketable products, with sale, licence, collaboration and joint-venture information and automated matching.

constraints.zh: 许可条件、适用场景与技术成熟度仍须交易双方协商，平台无法替代知识产权尽调。
constraints.en: Licensing terms, use conditions and maturity still require negotiation; the platform cannot replace IP due diligence.

transfer.zh: 开放平台宜同时结构化记录技术能力和真实需求，补充许可状态、试验条件和联络渠道。
transfer.en: Open platforms should structure both capabilities and demand, with licensing status, test conditions and contact routes.

title.zh: 联合国气候技术中心与网络需求驱动援助

summary.zh: 由发展中国家提出技术需求，经国家联络机构确认后，组织专家网络提供适配当地的技术支持。
summary.en: Developing countries request technology assistance through national focal points, with expert networks providing locally tailored support.

actors.zh: CTCN、国家指定实体、申请机构以及实施技术支持的网络成员。
actors.en: CTCN, National Designated Entities, applicants and implementing network members.

mechanism.zh: 国家联络机构核对需求与本国优先事项；中心与申请方形成支持方案，再选择实施伙伴。
mechanism.en: National focal points check alignment with priorities; CTCN and applicants design support plans and select implementing partners.

observed.zh: 官方流程依次包括国家需求确认、共同设计技术支持方案、选择实施伙伴；服务覆盖能力建设、技术试点与制度框架。
observed.en: The documented process covers national needs confirmation, support-plan design and implementing-partner selection, spanning capacity, pilots and institutional frameworks.

constraints.zh: 技术适配依赖受援机构能力和后续实施资源，专家报告不能自动转化为持续运营。
constraints.en: Suitability depends on recipient capabilities and implementation resources; expert advice does not automatically create sustained operation.

transfer.zh: 后发国家可用明确场景提出需求，将外部专家支持与本地组织、人员培训和后续融资衔接。
transfer.en: Latecomer countries can specify application needs and link external expertise with local organisations, training and follow-on financing.

title.zh: 印美太阳能研究联合体SERIIUS
title.en: India–US Solar Energy Research Institute SERIIUS

aliases: Solar Energy Research Institute for India

summary.zh: 联合印度与美国研究力量，围绕光伏和光热发电技术成本开展协作，衔接两国太阳能发展需求。
summary.en: Indian and US researchers collaborated on PV and concentrating solar power costs, aligning research with both countries' solar needs.

actors.zh: 印度科学研究院、NREL、桑迪亚国家实验室及相关研发伙伴。
actors.en: Indian Institute of Science, NREL, Sandia National Laboratories and research partners.

mechanism.zh: 联合体以共同技术任务组织研究；光热研究包括发电循环、集热器和接收器等环节。
mechanism.en: Shared tasks organise research, including power cycles, collectors and receivers for concentrating solar power.

observed.zh: 桑迪亚2012年报告记录光伏、光热研究任务；其公开的2016年光热循环技术经济论文注明SERIIUS资助，形成可追溯科研成果。
observed.en: Sandia's 2012 report records PV and CSP tasks; a public 2016 solar-cycle technoeconomic paper acknowledges SERIIUS support, providing a traceable research output.

constraints.zh: 这是历史合作案例，不能由早期研究计划推定目前仍按原规模运行，也不能把性能目标当成已实现指标。
constraints.en: This is a historical case: early plans do not establish current scale or achieved performance.

transfer.zh: 适合比较具有相近技术需求但不同应用条件的国家，联合任务需包含面向当地条件的试验和人才培养。
transfer.en: Joint tasks are useful where technical needs overlap but application conditions differ; local testing and training should be included.

title.zh: 南非HySA氢能研发与产业试验
title.en: South Africa HySA research and industrial testing

summary.zh: 高校、研究机构和企业围绕氢能设备与燃料电池开展研发，通过本地试验设施连接技术与产业应用。
summary.en: Universities, research institutions and firms develop hydrogen equipment and fuel cells, using local facilities to connect research and industrial applications.

actors.zh: 南非DSTI、西北大学、CSIR等HySA机构；部分示范与丰田南非合作。
actors.en: South Africa DSTI, North-West University and CSIR/HySA institutions; Toyota South Africa participates in a demonstration.

mechanism.zh: 专业中心形成研发分工，试验平台支持原型、部件和系统验证，产业伙伴参与应用示范。
mechanism.en: Specialised centres divide research tasks; platforms support prototype and system validation with industrial demonstrations.

observed.zh: 移动加氢设施于2025年2月建成，DSTI公开其与丰田南非的合作及设施交付；CSIR报告记录HySA专业中心间的分工。
observed.en: A mobile hydrogen refuelling facility was completed in February 2025; DSTI documents Toyota South Africa cooperation and handover, while CSIR records specialised centres.

constraints.zh: 示范设施证明了工程试验能力，但不能单独证明大规模氢能市场成熟或项目盈利。
constraints.en: Demonstration facilities establish testing capabilities, not the maturity or profitability of a large hydrogen market.

transfer.zh: 资源优势需与本地研发、知识产权和工程技能结合；先形成可测试的产品与应用再扩大产业链投资。
transfer.en: Combine resource advantages with local R&D, IP and engineering skills, testing products and applications before expanding investment.

title.zh: 澳大利亚CSIRO氢能产业任务

summary.zh: 以产业任务组织氢能研究、技术示范和国际合作，连接国内应用与出口价值链的技术需求。
summary.en: A mission links hydrogen research, demonstration and international cooperation with domestic and export value-chain needs.

actors.zh: CSIRO、澳大利亚研究团队、产业伙伴及海外研发机构。
actors.en: CSIRO, Australian researchers, industrial partners and overseas research organisations.

mechanism.zh: 产业任务将研究网络、国际合作和示范设施连接，用实际试验推动技术走向商业准备阶段。
mechanism.en: The mission connects research networks, international cooperation and facilities to test technologies approaching commercial readiness.

observed.zh: 官方记录Hadean Energy利用氢能示范设施测试千瓦级电解槽组件，并将国际研究合作作为产业任务的一部分。
observed.en: Official material records Hadean Energy testing a kilowatt-class electrolyser bundle and international research cooperation within the mission.

constraints.zh: 出口价值链取决于海外需求、成本与认证；研发合作不能消除这些市场约束。
constraints.en: Export chains depend on external demand, costs and certification; research partnerships do not remove these constraints.

transfer.zh: 用产业任务统筹研究和试验，但将技术验证、市场承诺与规模化投资分别评估。
transfer.en: Coordinate research and testing through a mission, while assessing technical validation, demand commitments and scale-up separately.

title.zh: 日法里昂智慧社区联合示范

summary.zh: 日本与法国在里昂城市更新中联合测试建筑节能、光伏管理、电动汽车共享和社区能源数据系统。
summary.en: Japan and France tested efficient buildings, PV management, EV sharing and community energy-data systems within Lyon's redevelopment.

actors.zh: NEDO、里昂都会区、东芝及法国合作企业。
actors.en: NEDO, Lyon Métropole, Toshiba and French partner companies.

mechanism.zh: 合作备忘录与实施协议衔接公共机构和企业，将能源技术嵌入城市规划与真实用户场景。
mechanism.en: A memorandum and implementation agreements connect public agencies and firms, embedding technology in planning and real user settings.

observed.zh: NEDO公开2011—2016年示范案例，包含正能量建筑、汽车共享及充电管理、家庭能耗可视化、社区能源管理四类任务。
observed.en: NEDO documents the 2011–2016 project: positive-energy buildings, EV sharing and charging, household consumption visualisation and community energy management.

constraints.zh: 建筑规范、用户行为和数据使用条件不同，技术跨境复制需要制度与运营同步适配。
constraints.en: Building rules, user behaviour and data-use conditions vary; transfer needs institutional and operational adaptation.

transfer.zh: 从城市真实需求出发选择试验场，明确公共部门、技术企业和居民各自的权责。
transfer.en: Select test sites around real urban needs and define responsibilities of public authorities, technology firms and residents.

title.zh: 英国ORE Catapult风电开放测试
title.en: UK ORE Catapult open wind testing

summary.zh: 开放大型测试设施与工程能力，联合产业伙伴验证风机、叶片和电气系统，衔接研发与认证需求。
summary.en: Large-scale facilities and engineering expertise help industrial partners validate turbines, blades and electrical systems for development and certification.

actors.zh: ORE Catapult、GE Renewable Energy等产业伙伴，以及研究与认证相关参与方。
actors.en: ORE Catapult, industrial partners including GE Renewable Energy, and research/certification participants.

mechanism.zh: 采用代表性试验与电网模拟等能力，减少研发测试对现场条件的依赖，连接研究、工程与产品验证。
mechanism.en: Representative testing and grid emulation connect research and engineering with product validation, reducing reliance on field conditions.

observed.zh: 公开资料记录GE风机测试合作；评估报告说明eGrid验证结果被英国电网接受用于替代部分现场数据。
observed.en: Public records document GE turbine testing; an evaluation describes National Grid acceptance of eGrid results in place of field data.

constraints.zh: 测试可支持合格评定，但不等于所有目的地市场自动认可；设备尺度和利用率影响设施经济性。
constraints.en: Testing can support conformity assessment but does not guarantee acceptance in every market; scale and utilisation affect facility economics.

transfer.zh: 共享大型测试设施比企业各自建设更适合共性验证需求，但需同步设计认可范围和产业参与机制。
transfer.en: Shared facilities suit common validation needs, provided recognition scope and industrial participation are designed together.

title.zh: 中美清洁汽车联合研发知识产权安排

aliases: 中美清洁能源研究中心

summary.zh: 清洁汽车联合研发通过技术管理计划约定知识产权利用，为跨国公私研究团队提供合作安排。
summary.en: A Technology Management Plan establishes IP-use arrangements for cross-border public–private clean-vehicle research.

actors.zh: 美国能源部、阿贡国家实验室、中国相关主管部门、清华大学及公私研究团队。
actors.en: US DOE, Argonne National Laboratory, Chinese authorities, Tsinghua University and public/private research teams.

mechanism.zh: 两国牵头机构组织团队和联合工作计划；技术管理计划对接既有清洁能源研究中心合作框架。
mechanism.en: National lead institutions organise teams and joint work plans; the management plan implements the CERC cooperation framework.

observed.zh: 美国能源部公布2016—2020年技术管理计划及阿贡国家实验室、清华大学的牵头安排，并标明文件不具法律约束力。
observed.en: DOE publishes the 2016–2020 plan and Argonne/Tsinghua lead arrangements, identifying the instrument as not legally binding.

constraints.zh: 历史协议不能证明当前合作持续；制度设计需区分合作意愿、合同可执行性和研究安全限制。
constraints.en: Historical agreements do not prove continuing cooperation; intent, contract enforceability and research-security limits must be distinguished.

transfer.zh: 可借鉴事先明确知识产权利用和双方牵头责任的做法，但应按现行规则评估协议效力与合作边界。
transfer.en: Define IP use and lead responsibilities in advance, while assessing enforceability and cooperation boundaries under current rules.

title.zh: 国际太阳能联盟STAR-C能力建设网络

aliases: 太阳能技术应用资源中心

summary.zh: 建设太阳能技术与应用资源中心网络，把培训、共享设施、测试和技术应用能力带入成员国。
summary.en: Solar technology resource centres connect training, shared facilities, testing and application capabilities across member countries.

actors.zh: 国际太阳能联盟、成员国与当地培训及技术机构；联盟由印度和法国共同发起。
actors.en: ISA, member countries and local training/technical institutions; the alliance originated with India and France.

mechanism.zh: 以国家或区域中心承接技能培养、技术知识和应用服务，连接本地机构与国际太阳能能力网络。
mechanism.en: National or regional centres provide skills, knowledge and application services, linking local institutions with an international network.

observed.zh: 官方项目资料列明资源中心的培训、测试、孵化及标准化功能，并记录2018—2019年来自25国的133人参加培训。
observed.en: Official project material identifies training, testing, incubation and standardisation functions and records 133 trainees from 25 countries in 2018–2019.

constraints.zh: 设备部署之外，本地运维人员、机构能力和可持续服务经费决定中心是否有效。
constraints.en: Beyond equipment, local maintenance skills, institutional capacity and sustainable service funding determine usefulness.

transfer.zh: 通过已有高校或技术机构构建区域资源中心，把人才培养与项目运维需求一起安排。
transfer.en: Build centres through existing universities or technical institutions and connect training with project operation needs.

title.zh: IECRE可再生能源国际合格评定

aliases: 可再生能源合格评定体系

summary.zh: 以统一规则和国际标准组织可再生能源设备合格评定，推动认证机构与测试实验室之间的一致实施。
summary.en: Common rules and international standards organise renewable-equipment conformity assessment across certification bodies and test laboratories.

actors.zh: IEC及IECRE体系中的认证机构、实验室、供应商和终端用户。
actors.en: IEC and certification bodies, laboratories, suppliers and end users participating in IECRE.

mechanism.zh: 规则统一证书含义、信息提交与合格评定流程，寻求减少重复工作并协调体系内分歧。
mechanism.en: Rules align certificate meanings, information requirements and assessment procedures, seeking to reduce duplication and resolve disagreements.

observed.zh: 体系规则统一证书含义和信息要求，公开证书平台支持检索已签发记录，为设备供应链提供可核查的合格评定入口。
observed.en: System rules align certificate meanings and information requirements; a public registry enables checks of issued certificates for equipment supply chains.

constraints.zh: 标准、检测能力与市场监管要求需要共同衔接，国际证书不能替代目的地法律合规。
constraints.en: Standards, testing capabilities and market rules need alignment; international certificates do not replace destination-law compliance.

transfer.zh: 对出口导向产业，建设可参与国际合格评定的实验室，比只增加本地标准数量更有针对性。
transfer.en: For export industries, develop laboratories able to participate in international assessment rather than merely adding domestic standards.

title.zh: 全球电池联盟电池护照试点

summary.zh: 电池企业、追溯服务商与供应链伙伴试验产品级可持续性数据采集，探索电池护照的规则与验证。
summary.en: Battery firms, traceability providers and supply-chain partners pilot product-level sustainability data collection and passport verification.

actors.zh: 全球电池联盟、试点联合体、电芯制造商、数字追溯服务商及供应链企业。
actors.en: GBA, pilot consortia, cell manufacturers, traceability providers and supply-chain firms.

mechanism.zh: 使用多方制定的规则采集数据并形成原型护照，以试验识别数据完整性、验证及互操作问题。
mechanism.en: Multistakeholder rules guide data collection and prototype passports, revealing completeness, verification and interoperability issues.

observed.zh: 2024年试点由10个联合体形成原型护照；报告同时指出不同追溯系统互操作性未在该轮测试，试点评分不可直接跨组比较。
observed.en: Ten consortia produced prototype passports in the 2024 pilots; the report notes untested inter-provider interoperability and non-comparable pilot scores.

constraints.zh: 这是数据治理探索而非成熟的统一认证。商业保密、供应链负担与验证口径仍需处理。
constraints.en: This is a governance pilot, not a mature universal certification; confidentiality, supplier burdens and verification conventions remain important.

transfer.zh: 推进产业数据平台时，先统一指标定义与证据要求，再测试跨平台交换，不以展示二维码替代可信数据。
transfer.en: Align indicators and evidence requirements before testing cross-platform exchange; a QR code cannot substitute for trustworthy data.

title.zh: 国际数据空间可信数据共享
title.en: International Data Spaces trusted data sharing

summary.zh: 通过参考架构、连接器与认证规则组织企业间数据共享，强调数据提供者对使用条件的控制。
summary.en: Reference architecture, connectors and certification organise inter-company sharing with provider control over data-use conditions.

actors.zh: 国际数据空间协会、成员组织、连接器开发者与数据空间参与方。
actors.en: IDSA, member organisations, connector developers and data-space participants.

mechanism.zh: 公开技术规范和认证框架连接身份、可信交换和数据使用控制，为协同研发与产业数据利用提供接口。
mechanism.en: Public specifications and certification connect identity, trusted exchange and usage control for research and industrial data collaboration.

observed.zh: 协会公开参考架构和认证框架，采用连接器、数据使用条件和可追溯机制组织可信交换，提供区别于全面集中数据的平台路径。
observed.en: Public architecture and certification frameworks use connectors, usage conditions and traceability for trusted exchange, offering an alternative to fully centralised platforms.

constraints.zh: 该案例为制度与技术基础设施对照，不是能源项目成果；技术可互通和法律可跨境须分别判断。
constraints.en: This is an institutional/technical comparator, not an energy-project outcome; technical interoperability and legal transferability are separate questions.

transfer.zh: 能源数据平台可采用可控共享而非全面集中：先界定数据用途、访问权限和审计责任，再连接多方。
transfer.en: Energy platforms can favour controlled sharing over full centralisation, defining purposes, access and audit responsibilities before interconnection.

title.zh: 欧洲InnoEnergy教育、创新与创业协同

summary.zh: 将创业教育、企业加速与能源创新支持结合，连接高校、产业和金融参与方。
summary.en: Entrepreneurial education, acceleration and energy-innovation support connect higher education, industry and finance.

actors.zh: EIT支持建立的知识与创新共同体、大学、企业、投资者与创新团队。
actors.en: An EIT-established Knowledge and Innovation Community, universities, firms, investors and innovators.

mechanism.zh: 国际教育与创业支持相衔接，通过网络连接业务开发、产业资源和创新技术商业化。
mechanism.en: International education connects with venture support and networks for business development, industrial resources and commercialisation.

observed.zh: EIT资料记载共同体2010年建立，创业加速、国际硕士教育和产业网络被组合为能源技术商业化支持体系。
observed.en: EIT documentation records establishment in 2010 and a combination of acceleration, international master's education and industrial networks supporting commercialisation.

constraints.zh: 平台网络可提供入口，但资本投入和市场准入仍需按技术与国家情境判断，不能由成员关系推定收益。
constraints.en: Networks provide access, but investment and market entry remain technology- and country-specific; membership does not establish returns.

transfer.zh: 将研究生培养与产业问题、创业实践和资本对接结合，保持技术能力与商业验证并重。
transfer.en: Combine graduate education with industrial challenges, venture practice and finance while retaining both technical and market validation.

title.zh: 肯尼亚气候创新中心本地创业与国际连接
title.en: Kenya Climate Innovation Center local ventures and global links

sector.zh: 太阳能、电动出行与气候技术
sector.en: Solar, electric mobility and climate technology

summary.zh: 向本地气候企业提供技术和商业支持，并通过大学及国际伙伴合作连接创新竞赛、孵化和融资。
summary.en: Local climate ventures receive technical and business support, linked to competitions, incubation and finance through university and international partnerships.

actors.zh: KCIC、肯尼亚企业、斯特拉斯莫尔大学，以及瑞士驻肯尼亚使馆和SICPA等合作方。
actors.en: KCIC, Kenyan ventures, Strathmore University, the Swiss Embassy in Kenya and SICPA.

mechanism.zh: 以创业团队的实际环境问题为起点，连接技术支持、市场信息、设施与融资准备。
mechanism.en: Support starts from practical environmental problems and links expertise, market intelligence, facilities and finance readiness.

observed.zh: 中心自2012年开展企业支持，公开太阳能、电动出行等领域服务；清洁技术竞赛与大学、瑞士机构合作吸纳早期团队。
observed.en: Operating since 2012, the centre documents solar and electric-mobility support; a university and Swiss-partner competition engages early-stage teams.

constraints.zh: 此模式侧重技术吸收和创业能力，并非所有团队都承担基础科学研究；竞赛入选不证明商业成功。
constraints.en: The focus is absorption and entrepreneurship rather than basic research in every venture; selection is not commercial success.

transfer.zh: 能力有限地区可先补足技术、市场与融资之间的接口，以应用需求筛选创新，而非照搬大型研发中心。
transfer.en: Regions with limited capacity can strengthen technical, market and finance interfaces, selecting demand-led innovations rather than copying large research centres.

title.zh: 绿色电力未来使命跨国协同

sector.zh: 电网、储能与可再生能源

summary.zh: 以共同创新路线图组织高比例可再生电力研究，比较不同地理与气候条件下的系统灵活性和集成路径。
summary.en: A shared roadmap coordinates high-renewable power research across geographies, focusing on flexibility and system integration.

actors.zh: 中国、意大利和英国共同牵头，其他参与方提供研究、政策和示范合作。
actors.en: China, Italy and the UK co-lead, with other participants contributing research, policy and demonstration cooperation.

mechanism.zh: 将技术优先事项、示范项目、数字工具与可复制性研究衔接，形成供不同国家选择的技术路径。
mechanism.en: Innovation priorities connect with demonstrations, digital tools and replicability studies to develop pathways for different countries.

observed.zh: 共同路线图于2021年11月发布，围绕可再生电力、系统灵活性和集成安排研究与示范；中国、意大利、英国共同牵头。
observed.en: A roadmap released in November 2021 organises research and demonstrations on renewable power, flexibility and integration, co-led by China, Italy and the UK.

constraints.zh: 电力市场、气候条件和灵活性资源不同，单一技术组合难以直接复制到所有国家。
constraints.en: Power markets, climate and flexibility resources differ; no single technology mix is directly transferable everywhere.

transfer.zh: 跨国共同任务应比较系统条件，在当地电网约束下验证储能、需求响应和控制技术的组合。
transfer.en: Joint tasks should compare system conditions and validate storage, demand response and control combinations under local grid constraints.

title.zh: IEA PVPS光伏可靠性跨气候研究
title.en: IEA PVPS Task 13 cross-climate reliability research

summary.zh: 汇集不同气候区光伏运行资料与试验经验，支持组件质量、可靠性和发电量评估。
summary.en: Operating data and testing experience from different climates support assessments of PV quality, reliability and yield.

actors.zh: IEA PVPS Task 13研究团队及参与机构、行业使用者。
actors.en: IEA PVPS Task 13 researchers, participating institutions and industry users.

mechanism.zh: 跨区域研究对比新应用和环境条件，形成可供项目开发、运营与质量管理使用的报告。
mechanism.en: Cross-regional research compares applications and environments, producing reports for development, operation and quality management.

observed.zh: 官方列明2026—2029年跨气候光伏研究，2026年项目决策报告把质量管理、发电性能和经济价值连贯分析。
observed.en: Official material identifies the 2026–2029 cross-climate research phase; a 2026 report links quality management, performance and economic value.

constraints.zh: 运行数据的可比性取决于试验条件、采样和指标口径；建议并非具有强制力的全球统一标准。
constraints.en: Comparability depends on testing conditions, sampling and indicator conventions; guidance is not a binding global standard.

transfer.zh: 技术引进应配套本地气候运行数据与可靠性验证，利用国际研究降低重复试验而非省略当地验证。
transfer.en: Technology adoption should include local operating data and reliability checks, using international work to reduce duplication rather than eliminate local validation.
